subject: English
description: A gentle starter lesson that helps students read slowly, repeat clearly, and understand simply.

lines.text: We learn better when we help each other.
lines.explanation: Jab hum ek dusre ki help karte hain, to learning easy ho jati hai.

lines.text: A friend can explain a hard word in a simple way.
lines.explanation: Dost mushkil shabd ko simple Hinglish mein samjha sakta hai.

lines.text: The classroom feels brighter when everyone joins in.
lines.explanation: Sab participate karte hain to class lively aur achhi lagti hai.

lines.hint: Try saying the idea in your own words.

lines.text: Small steps every day make strong habits.
lines.explanation: Roz thoda-thoda padhna ek strong habit banata hai.
